podcast.title: Contrast on "Boy Meets Girls"
podcast.body: Adam Faith was among the acts appearing on the British TV program "Boy Meets Girls." His performance contributed to the backdrop against which Gene Vincent's distinctive "mean, moody leatherclad rock and roll" image on screen became particularly striking and memorable. "on a show like Boy Meets Girls, where the rest of the acts were people like Cliff Richard or Adam Faith, having a mean, moody leatherclad rock and roll on screen was instantly captivating."

podcast.title: Teen Idol
podcast.body: He was part of a wave of teen idols who followed Tommy Steele's rise, many of whom were managed by Larry Parns. "In the wake of Steele came a whole host of other teen idols along the same lines, most of them managed by Larry Parns."
